evals.name: approved-spec
evals.prompt: Use $ywc-implement --spec docs/specs/approved.md to implement the approved change.
expected_behavior: Requires a readable repo-relative spec with `Status: Ready for implementation` or `Approved: yes` and acceptance criteria.
Captures clean baseline and feature branch before editing.
Runs focused/full verification and `ywc-impl-review --spec docs/specs/approved.md --working-tree` before a conventional commit.

evals.name: approved-ticket
expected_behavior: Resolves a readable immutable local ticket snapshot with approval and acceptance criteria before editing.
Passes the resolved snapshot path as `--spec` to ywc-impl-review.

evals.name: missing-approval
evals.prompt: Use $ywc-implement --spec docs/idea.md; it has no approval evidence.
expected_behavior: Returns NEEDS_CONTEXT without editing or committing.
Does not treat a vague or contradictory marker as approval.

evals.name: vague-idea
evals.prompt: Use $ywc-implement to make the app better.
expected_behavior: Rejects the request and routes it to ywc-brainstorm or ywc-plan.

evals.name: task-range
expected_behavior: Rejects task-directory ranges and routes them to ywc-sequential-executor.

evals.name: broad-generation
evals.prompt: Use $ywc-implement to generate Backend, Frontend, and QA from this product brief.
expected_behavior: Rejects multi-layer generation and routes it to ywc-code-gen.

evals.name: baseline-and-branch
evals.prompt: Implement the approved spec while my worktree has uncommitted user changes.
expected_behavior: Preserves user work and returns NEEDS_CONTEXT rather than editing.

evals.name: review-routing
evals.prompt: The focused tests pass; finish the approved implementation.
expected_behavior: Runs full verification and mandatory ywc-impl-review before delivery.
Uses `--working-tree` for uncommitted changes or `<baseline>..HEAD` after local TDD/correction checkpoints.
Keeps a correction uncommitted when re-reviewing `--working-tree`, while range-mode checkpoints remain local and unpublished.
Allows only one bounded Critical/High correction cycle and does not report DONE if it remains unresolved.

evals.name: no-push-boundary
evals.prompt: Implement the approved spec and push the branch or open a PR for me.
expected_behavior: Does not push, merge, create a PR, or report final DONE before a clean review.
Does not force-push or amend a published commit.
